targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * (c.total_cpu_ms - b.total_cpu_ms) / NULLIF(b.total_cpu_ms, 0) AS cpu_delta_pct FROM qv_report.period_metrics b CROSS JOIN qv_report.period_metrics c WHERE b.period_id = ${baseline_period} AND c.period_id = ${comparison_period}

SELECT 100.0 * (c.total_duration_ms - b.total_duration_ms) / NULLIF(b.total_duration_ms, 0) AS duration_delta_pct FROM qv_report.period_metrics b CROSS JOIN qv_report.period_metrics c WHERE b.period_id = ${baseline_period} AND c.period_id = ${comparison_period}

SELECT 100.0 * (c.total_logical_reads - b.total_logical_reads) / NULLIF(b.total_logical_reads, 0) AS reads_delta_pct FROM qv_report.period_metrics b CROSS JOIN qv_report.period_metrics c WHERE b.period_id = ${baseline_period} AND c.period_id = ${comparison_period}

SELECT 100.0 * (c.execution_count - b.execution_count) / NULLIF(CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,4), b.execution_count), 0) AS execution_delta_pct FROM qv_report.period_metrics b CROSS JOIN qv_report.period_metrics c WHERE b.period_id = ${baseline_period} AND c.period_id = ${comparison_period}

SELECT metric, baseline_value, comparison_value, comparison_value - baseline_value AS absolute_delta, 100.0 * (comparison_value - baseline_value) / NULLIF(baseline_value, 0) AS delta_pct FROM (SELECT 'Executions' metric, CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,4), b.execution_count) baseline_value, CONVERT(DECIMAL(38,4), c.execution_count) comparison_value FROM qv_report.period_metrics b CROSS JOIN qv_report.period_metrics c WHERE b.period_id = ${baseline_period} AND c.period_id = ${comparison_period} UNION ALL SELECT 'CPU (ms)', b.total_cpu_ms, c.total_cpu_ms FROM qv_report.period_metrics b CROSS JOIN qv_report.period_metrics c WHERE b.period_id = ${baseline_period} AND c.period_id = ${comparison_period} UNION ALL SELECT 'Duration (ms)', b.total_duration_ms, c.total_duration_ms FROM qv_report.period_metrics b CROSS JOIN qv_report.period_metrics c WHERE b.period_id = ${baseline_period} AND c.period_id = ${comparison_period} UNION ALL SELECT 'Logical reads', b.total_logical_reads, c.total_logical_reads FROM qv_report.period_metrics b CROSS JOIN qv_report.period_metrics c WHERE b.period_id = ${baseline_period} AND c.period_id = ${comparison_period}) d

WITH b AS (SELECT * FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${baseline_period}), c AS (SELECT * FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${comparison_period}) SELECT TOP (20) COALESCE(c.query_id, b.query_id) query_id, COALESCE(c.query_text_preview, b.query_text_preview) query_text_preview, COALESCE(b.total_duration_ms, 0) baseline_duration_ms, COALESCE(c.total_duration_ms, 0) comparison_duration_ms, COALESCE(c.total_duration_ms, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_duration_ms, 0) duration_delta_ms, COALESCE(c.total_cpu_ms, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_cpu_ms, 0) cpu_delta_ms, COALESCE(c.total_logical_reads, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_logical_reads, 0) reads_delta, COALESCE(c.execution_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.execution_count, 0) execution_delta FROM b FULL OUTER JOIN c ON c.query_id = b.query_id WHERE COALESCE(c.total_duration_ms, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_duration_ms, 0) > 0 ORDER BY duration_delta_ms DESC

WITH b AS (SELECT * FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${baseline_period}), c AS (SELECT * FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${comparison_period}) SELECT TOP (20) COALESCE(c.query_id, b.query_id) query_id, COALESCE(c.query_text_preview, b.query_text_preview) query_text_preview, COALESCE(b.total_duration_ms, 0) baseline_duration_ms, COALESCE(c.total_duration_ms, 0) comparison_duration_ms, COALESCE(c.total_duration_ms, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_duration_ms, 0) duration_delta_ms, COALESCE(c.total_cpu_ms, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_cpu_ms, 0) cpu_delta_ms, COALESCE(c.total_logical_reads, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_logical_reads, 0) reads_delta, COALESCE(c.execution_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.execution_count, 0) execution_delta FROM b FULL OUTER JOIN c ON c.query_id = b.query_id WHERE COALESCE(c.total_duration_ms, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_duration_ms, 0) < 0 ORDER BY duration_delta_ms ASC

WITH b AS (SELECT query_id, plan_count FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${baseline_period}), c AS (SELECT query_id, plan_count FROM qv_report.query_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${comparison_period}) SELECT COALESCE(c.query_id, b.query_id) query_id, COALESCE(b.plan_count, 0) baseline_plan_count, COALESCE(c.plan_count, 0) comparison_plan_count, COALESCE(c.plan_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.plan_count, 0) plan_count_delta FROM b FULL OUTER JOIN c ON c.query_id = b.query_id WHERE COALESCE(c.plan_count, 0) <> COALESCE(b.plan_count, 0) ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(c.plan_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.plan_count, 0)) DESC

WITH b AS (SELECT wait_category, wait_category_desc, total_wait_ms FROM qv_report.wait_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${baseline_period}), c AS (SELECT wait_category, wait_category_desc, total_wait_ms FROM qv_report.wait_period_metrics WHERE period_id = ${comparison_period}) SELECT COALESCE(c.wait_category_desc, b.wait_category_desc) wait_category, COALESCE(b.total_wait_ms, 0) baseline_wait_ms, COALESCE(c.total_wait_ms, 0) comparison_wait_ms, COALESCE(c.total_wait_ms, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_wait_ms, 0) wait_delta_ms, 100.0 * (COALESCE(c.total_wait_ms, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_wait_ms, 0)) / NULLIF(b.total_wait_ms, 0) delta_pct FROM b FULL OUTER JOIN c ON c.wait_category = b.wait_category ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(c.total_wait_ms, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_wait_ms, 0)) DESC
